A Fresh Start for Your Home

FreshNest Cleaning Co. is a fictional Tampa-area home cleaning concept. The service experience is designed around your space, schedule, and priorities, with clear expectations before a cleaning visit is arranged.

A simple way to get started

  1. Tell us about your home, the rooms you want cleaned, and the type of service you need.
  2. Share your preferred schedule, priorities, access notes, and any product or surface considerations.
  3. Review the proposed scope and estimate before confirming a real appointment.

Cleaning Options for Different Needs

  • Recurring Home Cleaning

    Maintain a comfortable home with weekly, biweekly, or monthly visits. Set priorities for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, and high-use surfaces so each visit follows an agreed scope.

  • Deep Cleaning

    Give extra attention to buildup and overlooked areas. A deep-clean request can cover detailed kitchen and bathroom work, baseboards, fixtures, and other agreed priorities beyond a routine visit.

  • Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning

    Prepare a property for a new resident or help leave a space ready after a move. Confirm whether cabinets, appliances, inside windows, closets, and other add-ons are included in the estimate.

  • Office & Small Business Cleaning

    Discuss a cleaning schedule for offices and small workplaces. Define room access, operating hours, shared areas, restrooms, waste handling, and any site-specific requirements before service.

  • Shower & Fixture Installation

    Replace faucets, showerheads, and other kitchen or bathroom fixtures.

Frequently Asked Questions

What information is needed for a cleaning estimate?

Share the property type, approximate size or number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the service you need, preferred timing, and any areas that need special attention.

What is usually included in a standard home cleaning?

The scope often covers agreed kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, living-area, and floor tasks. Confirm the exact checklist, exclusions, and add-on pricing with the cleaning provider before booking.

How is deep cleaning different from recurring cleaning?

Recurring cleaning focuses on maintaining an agreed routine. Deep cleaning usually allows more time for buildup and detailed areas that may not be part of every maintenance visit.

Do I need to be home during the cleaning?

That depends on the provider's access policy and your preference. Discuss key or entry arrangements, pets, alarms, and any rooms that should remain off limits.

Do you provide cleaning supplies?

Supply policies vary. Confirm whether the cleaner brings products and equipment, whether you can request particular products, and whether any surface-care restrictions apply.

Is FreshNest Cleaning Co. a real business?

No. FreshNest Cleaning Co. is a fictional website concept using Tampa, Florida as an example market. The contact details, services, credentials, reviews, and business information are placeholders.
